result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the 1861 Paris prize problem on heat conduction: Riemann computes the curvature-type expressions (11), (22), (33), (23), (13), (12) for a quadratic differential form with coefficients a, c, m depending on α, β, γ, sets them to zero to test whether the form can be reduced to constant coefficients, and integrates the resulting ODEs for a function f such as K f'' + K_1^2 f'/f^3 = 0.

methods.what: Quadratic differential form with variable coefficients a, c, m under study, with its coefficient determinant
General expression for the curvature (Riemann four-index) quantities of a quadratic form in terms of second derivatives of coefficients and Christoffel-type p symbols
Setting the curvature components (13) to zero and integrating via logarithmic derivative
Ansatz separating c as product of v and a function of α+β
Reduction to an ODE for f with constants, and first integrals
